tests.name: Actions and host regression
tests.evidence: Eight Python tests, C++ passwordless LAN boundary and existing policy tests, JS server-challenge/no-auth/cancel/reconnect tests, and 12 concurrent TLS ASan/UBSan rounds passed.

tests.name: DEB integrity and safe defaults
tests.evidence: Local validator matches CI SHA256: com.dk.viewphone 1.1.2, roothide, four signed arm64 binaries, 204 payload entries, assets match source; passwordless defaults off.

tests.name: Password mode retained
tests.evidence: Real native VNC offered security type 2 and returned a framebuffer; Chrome login succeeded with the temporary valid credential and rejected one wrong credential.

tests.name: Passwordless LAN HTTP/WS
tests.evidence: Chrome connected without submitting a password; native RFB offered security type None (1) and returned a framebuffer. Saved passwords are ignored only in opted-in mode.

tests.name: Tap and client view-only
tests.evidence: Calculator 0 remained unchanged for a view-only tap, then the same full-control tap displayed 2; private screenshots inspected.

tests.name: Server Remote Control off
tests.evidence: Passwordless full-control viewer remained unable to tap with RemoteControlEnabled=false.

tests.name: Automatic no-password recovery
tests.evidence: Injected SIGKILL; watchdog recovered and Chrome reconnected without a login dialog within the 15-second observation window, then received a framebuffer.

tests.name: Manual Disconnect
tests.evidence: After manual Disconnect, waited six seconds: remained disconnected with Connect enabled.

tests.name: HTTPS/WSS passwordless
tests.evidence: Actual HTTPS/WSS connected without a password. Temporary self-signed IP-SAN fixture accepted only in isolated test context; Windows trust store unchanged.

tests.name: Trusted LAN opt-in required
tests.evidence: With passwordless enabled and Trusted LAN disabled, both listeners closed and the existing invalid-configuration guard switched Enabled off. Restoring consent and explicitly enabling the server again recovered native None and web access.

tests.name: Original preferences retained and final URL active
tests.evidence: After restoring original preferences, applied only the requested LAN/no-password settings. Independent compare confirmed unrelated values, including existing credentials, were preserved; final Chrome None login and native listener checks passed.

tests.name: Final short-run crash inventory
tests.evidence: Final crash inventory contained only the four previously recorded 1.1.1 development-candidate reports. No new report during this 1.1.2 session; deliberate SIGKILL and the policy guard disabling the server are distinguished in diagnostics.

tests.name: New native Settings toggle UI acceptance
tests.evidence: Compiled/parsed the Settings resource and exercised its preference via CFPreferences. Full manual toggle/Apply UI acceptance not run.

tests.name: Physical Wi-Fi loss and DHCP change
tests.evidence: No physical Wi-Fi or lease-change test in this session.

tests.name: 24-hour soak and reboot
tests.evidence: Owner previously deferred these checks; no long-term or leak-free claim.

tests.name: Edge and keyboard-specific acceptance
tests.evidence: This session used Chrome; these cases were not separately rerun.
